column1: # Stage0 coverage gaps, not proof that every listed role is consumed.
# Unreviewed means the command has an operand but no curated role contract.
# Mixed applicability must be reviewed; a one-operand command can mark those tuples inapplicable in its role review.
# A covered coarse tuple still needs its plane, parameter branch and interactive/UI obligations.
# The sweep's works/refused result never counts as a curated numeric or typed-refusal row.
